style_name: Shadow Economics & Resource Cartels (2D Cinematic Storybook Stickman)

acts.name: The Paradox Hook
acts.goal: A staggering economic paradox: why a beach is vanishing overnight, or why an empty oil tanker is worth more dead than alive. Hook with a quiet maritime or customs anomaly.

acts.name: The Fragile Routine
acts.goal: The lone investigator stickman inspecting a mundane shipping manifest or harbor gate under rainy streetlamps while a shadow cartel moves billions.

acts.name: The Supply Chain Domino
acts.goal: Deconstruct the illicit logistics network: shell company jurisdictions, AIS transponder spoofing, river dredgers, forged bills of lading.

acts.name: The Cold Epilogue
acts.goal: The unpunished reality: how the legal economy quietly relies on the shadow commodity to survive, and how it touches everyday consumer goods.

flow.character_guide: Minimalist stickman investigator character with smooth off-white round head, simple black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, wearing a simple beige trench coat with natural fabric folds and a simple dark fedora hat
flow.look: Wide 2D cinematic storybook illustration, hand-painted matte digital art, European graphic novel aesthetic (bande dessinée / ligne claire noir), uncluttered composition, generous negative space, atmospheric depth. Minimalist stickman investigator character with smooth off-white round head, simple black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, wearing a simple beige trench coat with natural fabric folds and a simple dark fedora hat. Environment: night industrial container terminal dock, towering dark silhouette of an unflagged cargo freighter in rainy black water, sodium harbor light reflections on wet cracked pavement. Single continuous 16:9 widescreen frame. Single camera view. Absolutely NO comic book panels, NO multi-panel grids, NO split screens, NO borders.

editorial.voice: Cynical, sharp, investigative noir narrator. Speaks with understated authority and biting, deadpan wit. Paces sentences evenly, pausing calmly when revealing astronomical dollar amounts or counterfeit shipping tonnages.
rules: Micro-substance: cite real ship IMO numbers, specific customs tariff codes, maritime port registry flags of convenience, and dollar margin spreads per ton.
No glamorization: depict shadow cartels as ruthless, unglamorous logistics operations run on spreadsheets, bribes, and rusted barges.
4-Act structure: The Paradox Hook -> The Fragile Routine -> The Supply Chain Domino -> The Cold Epilogue.
